Container.Name: moonrise-server
Container.Overview: Moonrise is a video player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV with its own server. The server reads your video folders (on this machine or on SMB shares), recognises movies and shows, fetches artwork and plots, and streams to the Moonrise apps: instant seeking, every audio track, subtitles, downloads for offline viewing, transcoding when a device needs it.[br][br]After installing, open the Moonrise app: it finds the server on your network and guides you through setup (the 6-digit setup code is in this container's log and on the WebUI page).[br][br]Hardware transcoding is detected by itself: for an Intel or AMD GPU fill in the GPU device (/dev/dri); for NVIDIA install the Nvidia-Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters and fill in NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES.
Container.Requires: Optional: an Intel/AMD GPU (/dev/dri) or an NVIDIA GPU (Nvidia-Driver plugin) for hardware transcoding.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The server's database, subtitles, artwork and stream cache. Back it up.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Optional: a video folder on this server, read-only (pick it in the app). Shares on other machines are added in the app instead.

Config.Name: Listen address
Config.Description: Address and port (the apps look for 8097).

Config.Name: Cache folder
Config.Description: Stream segments and prepared downloads (size limit set in the app).

Config.Name: Restart from the app
Config.Description: exit: the app's Restart Server exits the server and Docker starts it again.

Config.Name: Hardware transcoding
Config.Description: auto finds NVIDIA, Intel Quick Sync, VA-API (Intel/AMD), else the CPU.

Config.Name: Intel/AMD GPU
Config.Description: For Intel Quick Sync or VA-API: /dev/dri

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: For NVIDIA: all (or a GPU's UUID), with --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters.
